name: GitKraken
tagline: GitKraken's solo core is compact: build a repository-local Git client assistant that indexes one codebase, calls one model, proposes diffs, runs tests, and records every change. A competent builder can reach a useful personal version in one sitting, while the paid product mainly wins on model, context, integration.
verdictSummary: YES: GitKraken has usage-based pricing. Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
